title: Almost 100 Vibe-Coded Games. This Blew Up Faster Than I Expected!
author: CuntsAndBluntss
selftext:
First of all, thank you for all massively submitting your games!

A couple of months ago, I started building VibeToplist because I couldn't find a single place dedicated to discovering AI-assisted and vibe-coded games, something I am hugely invested and interested in.

What started as a small side project for a pretty niche community has now grown to almost 100 unique game listings, with thousands of visitors discovering new games every week.

The growth has genuinely been beyond anything I expected. It's especially cool seeing how creative and ambitious some of these projects are becoming.

If you're developing an AI-assisted game yourself, you're more than welcome to list it for free. The idea is simple, help developers get discovered by an audience that's already interested in exactly what they're building. Organic traffic and an SEO backlink to help your game project grow.

Really curious to see where this whole space will be a year from now.

[https://vibetoplist.com/](https://vibetoplist.com/)

comments.author: kokutouchichi
comments.body:
the site layout is all broken on my android galaxy phone but I'm glad someone is making a site like this. One thing I would like to humbly ask on behalf of my fellow naughty developers is a section for adult games. You can put it behind an Are you 18 pop-up age check or whatever other checks is fine but there are fewer and fewer places online where adult game devs can list their games let alone marketplaces to accept payments for adult games.

Sure I understand the want to keep it clean but I assure you if you make a space for adult creators you will have a huge bump in traffic. It also seems like you aren't even hosting anything and just linking to places like itch which already host the majority of adult games but many of those are also shadow banned.

Just a suggestion, I would love link some of my adult games here too if possible!

replies.author: CuntsAndBluntss
replies.body: I will think about it, games are heavily tied to children/kids so my initial thought would be not to allow such a thing. It has to be a decent filter. I will let you know.
